title: DWG callback null-writer guard and HATCH gradient CMC fast test
scope: Prevent the DXF-only dx_iface object-emission callback from dereferencing a null DXF writer when invoked during DWG serialization; register focused generated gradient-CMC regressions covering inline and detached strings.

evidence.diagnosis: AddressSanitizer located the null read in dx_iface::writeObjects() at resolvedBackgroundHandles(); dwgRW::write() invokes this callback, while dx_iface::dxfW is intentionally null in DWG context.
evidence.invariant: DXF object-record projection is a no-op when no DXF writer is attached; the DWG writer owns and emits its separate object stream.
evidence.semanticLimit: The C4-C8 gradient CMC cases remain opaque same-version preservation only; this guard does not establish CMC producer semantics, ACIS/ACDS semantics, or consumer support.

matrixRoutes: AC1018 direct-reader parse and byte-identical same-version replay
AC1024 DWG write/readback through the detached string stream

validation.result: PASS (AddressSanitizer; selector completed without memory errors)

repositoryState.reason: The shared worktree is broadly dirty, and the callback depends on surrounding in-progress DXF object-handle projection changes; staging the full files would include unrelated work.
